speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Welcome to your consultation. To begin understanding the cause of your acute diarrhea, please tell me when your symptoms started and how frequent your bowel movements are. Additionally, have you noticed any blood, mucus, or fever accompanying these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely *C. difficile* infection) secondary to levofloxacin therapy.

I have already established the key risk factors in your history: recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the development of frequent watery diarrhea with abdominal cramping. To confirm the diagnosis, I am requesting your stool test results.

REQUEST TEST: C_diff_toxin_stool_assay
